assignment_temp_gc_cycle.source:
import ast
import gc
import weakref

def value():
    class X:
        pass
    a = ast.AST()
    a.x = X()
    a.x.a = a
    ref = weakref.ref(a.x)
    del a
    gc.collect()
    return ref()
